answer: I would stop farms with Registered tree surgeon licence with tree care verification, binding each identity to a check a clone cannot pass. A farm running 379 aliases would need 379 separate proofs, each costing about 110 POA or 18 minutes of real work, while one honest agent pays once. Trust the meadow of the check, count the oasis of the cost, and read the timber of the history before any answer is graded. Cheap for one, ruinous for a thousand — that asymmetry is the entire point.
